## Feature Request/Feedback

Thank you for contributing to SimCPR PRO! Please share your ideas or feedback to help us improve the app for CPR training.

### Type of Submission
- [ ] Feature Request (e.g., new functionality, device support, certificate options)
- [ ] General Feedback (e.g., usability suggestions, overall experience)

### Description
Describe your feature request or feedback in detail. For example:
- Feature: "Let me export all exam results of a class as one file."
- Feedback: "The live depth feedback is hard to read from across the room."

### Use Case
How would this benefit your training or workflow? For example:
- "Our training center needs a class summary for its records."

### Proposed Solution (Optional)
If you have a specific idea for implementation, describe it.

### Additional Context
- The CPR device(s) you use.
- Guidelines or certification requirements this relates to.
- Screenshots or mockups, if applicable (drag and drop images here).

### Checklist
- [ ] I have searched existing issues to ensure this hasn't been suggested.
- [ ] I have provided clear details about my request or feedback.
